CertificationsMC Miaki

Every farm in the group is audited by independent sustainability and quality programs. For buyers, that means coffee of known origin, produced responsibly.

5 seals · 6 estates · 100% traceable

01 / 05
Rainforest Alliance

Rainforest Alliance

International seal for sustainable agriculture. Independent audits check, farm by farm, how forests, water, soil and the people working the land are cared for.

  • Protection of biodiversity and native forest
  • Responsible use of water, soil and crop protection
  • Workers' rights and well-being
On all 6 estatesrainforest-alliance.org
02 / 05
Nespresso AAA Sustainable Quality Program

Nespresso AAA

Nespresso's program combining cup quality and sustainability. Only farms that deliver top-grade coffee and follow responsible practices, monitored by field agronomists, take part.

  • Top-grade cup quality
  • Good agricultural practices monitored in the field
  • Long-term relationship with the grower
On all 6 estatessustainability.nespresso.com
03 / 05
Starbucks · Coffee and Farmer Equity

C.A.F.E. Practices

Starbucks' ethical sourcing guidelines, verified by independent organizations. They assess quality, economic transparency, social responsibility and environmental leadership.

  • Product quality
  • Social and economic responsibility
  • Environmental leadership
On all 6 estatesstarbucks.com
04 / 05
Now part of Rainforest Alliance

UTZ Certified

A sustainable coffee program the group's farms followed for years. In 2018 UTZ merged with Rainforest Alliance, and its criteria live on within the current seal.

  • Good farming and management practices
  • Lot traceability
  • Safe working conditions
On all 6 estatesrainforest-alliance.org
05 / 05
Cerrado Coffee Growers Federation

Cerrado Mineiro Region

Brazil's first Designation of Origin for coffee. The seal guarantees the coffee was grown in the region, by registered growers, with origin and quality proven lot by lot.

  • Protected geographic origin
  • Grower and lot identified
  • Quality assessed before the seal is granted
On all 6 estatescerradomineiro.org
01 / For buyers

What the seals guarantee.

Each certification has its own standard, but together they cover what a demanding buyer looks for: origin, quality and respect for people and nature.

Proven origin

Farm, plot, variety and processing on record. Every lot is identified from the field to the warehouse.

Independent audits

Regular visits by external auditors check practices in the field, on the patio and in the warehouse.

Sustainable production

Protected native forest, responsible use of water and soil, integrated management and a trained, safe team.
